source.text: תְּ֭פִלָּה לְעָנִ֣י כִֽי־יַעֲטֹ֑ף וְלִפְנֵ֥י יְ֝הוָ֗ה יִשְׁפֹּ֥ךְ שִׂיחֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: A prayer of [one who is] afflicted, when he grows faint and before YHWH pours out his complaint.

en.L: A prayer of [one who is] afflicted, when {{gender:that one|he}} grows faint and pours out {{gender:their|his}} complaint before {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.B: A prayer of someone in deep trouble, who is worn out and pours out a complaint before {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.R: A prayer for someone who is suffering and feels weak, and tells {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} all about it.

fr.L: Une prière de [celui qui est] affligé, quand il défaille et répand sa plainte devant {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.
fr.B: Une prière de quelqu’un qui est dans une profonde détresse, qui est à bout de forces et répand sa plainte devant {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.
fr.R: Une prière pour quelqu’un qui souffre et se sent faible, et qui raconte tout {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}}.

sw.L: Maombi ya [mtu] mnyonge, anapozimia na kumimina malalamiko yake mbele za {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.B: Maombi ya mtu aliye katika taabu kubwa, aliyechoka kabisa, anayemimina malalamiko yake mbele za {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.R: Maombi kwa ajili ya mtu anayeteseka na kujisikia dhaifu, naye anamweleza {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} yote yanayomsumbua.

decisions.choice: The title is verse 1
decisions.reason: The title is part of the Hebrew text and is counted as verse 1, so the verse numbers here are one higher than in Bibles that print the title without a number.

decisions.choice: a prayer for anyone in trouble
decisions.reason: Unlike most titles, this one names no author or musical direction. It says when the prayer is to be used: by anyone who is crushed and worn out. Verses 13-23 widen it to the ruin of Zion.

decisions.choice: grows faint: is weak and overcome
decisions.reason: The verb ('ataf) is used of a spirit or life that grows weak and fails (61:3; 142:4).

decisions.choice: complaint: an anxious pouring out of trouble
decisions.reason: The word (siach) is earnest talk, a troubled complaint (55:3; 142:3); in 104:34 the same word is a song of musing.

decisions.choice: that one, their (with "he", "his" as the alternatives)
decisions.reason: The title means anyone who is suffering (m2), so Literal gives inclusive wording by default with the traditional words as the alternative; Balanced and Readable say "someone".

decisions.choice: A prayer for someone
decisions.reason: Readable makes clear that the prayer is offered for anyone to pray (m2).

decisions.choice: no gender setting at Literal: "celui qui est affligé ... il ... sa plainte"
alternatives: a span on the pronouns, as the English has
decisions.reason: French puts the gender setting on nouns only; "celui qui" and the "il" that refers back to it already mean anyone, and "sa" is the same for a man or a woman.

source.text: יְ֭הוָה שִׁמְעָ֣ה תְפִלָּתִ֑י וְ֝שַׁוְעָתִ֗י אֵלֶ֥יךָ תָבֽוֹא׃

records.literal_gloss: YHWH, hear my prayer, and my cry for help to you let it come.

en.L: {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, hear my prayer, and let my cry for help come to {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}.
en.B: {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, listen to my prayer; let my call for help reach {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}.
en.R: {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, hear me as I pray! Let my cry for help reach {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}.

fr.L: {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, écoute ma prière, et que mon cri au secours parvienne jusqu’à {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}.
fr.B: {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, écoute ma prière ; que mon appel au secours arrive jusqu’à {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}.
fr.R: {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, écoute-moi quand je prie ! Que mon cri au secours arrive jusqu’à {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}.

sw.L: Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, sikia maombi yangu, na kilio changu cha kuomba msaada kikufikie.
sw.B: Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, uyasikilize maombi yangu; kilio changu cha kuomba msaada kikufikie.
sw.R: Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, unisikie ninapoomba! Kilio changu cha kuomba msaada kikufikie.

decisions.choice: cry for help: a shout for rescue
decisions.reason: The word (shav'ah) is a cry for help in danger (18:7; 39:13).

source.text: אַל־תַּסְתֵּ֬ר פָּנֶ֨יךָ׀מִמֶּנִּי֮ בְּי֪וֹם צַ֫ר לִ֥י הַטֵּֽה־אֵלַ֥י אָזְנֶ֑ךָ בְּי֥וֹם אֶ֝קְרָ֗א מַהֵ֥ר עֲנֵֽנִי׃

records.literal_gloss: Do not hide your face from me on [the] day [when there is] distress to me; incline to me your ear; on [the] day I call, hurry, answer me.

en.L: Do not hide {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} face from me on the day of my distress; incline {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} ear to me; on the day I call, hurry, answer me.
en.B: Do not turn {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} face away from me on the day trouble presses me hard. Bend down and listen to me; on the day I call, be quick to answer.
en.R: Do not turn away from me when I am in trouble. Listen to me! When I call to {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}, answer me right away.

fr.L: Ne {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} cache pas {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} face au jour de ma détresse ; incline vers moi {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} oreille ; au jour où j’appelle, hâte-{{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}, réponds-moi.
fr.B: Ne détourne pas de moi {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} visage au jour où le malheur m’accable. Penche-{{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} et écoute-moi ; au jour où j’appelle, réponds vite.
fr.R: Ne {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} détourne pas de moi quand je suis dans le malheur. Écoute-moi ! Quand je {{deity_pronoun:t’|T’}}appelle, réponds-moi tout de suite.

sw.L: Usinifiche uso {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} siku ya taabu yangu; unitegee sikio {{deity_pronoun:lako|Lako}}; siku ninapoita, fanya haraka, unijibu.
sw.B: Usiugeuze uso {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} mbali nami siku ambayo taabu inanisonga sana. Uiname unisikilize; siku ninapoita, uwe mwepesi kunijibu.
sw.R: Usinigeuzie mgongo ninapokuwa katika taabu. Unisikilize! Ninapokuita, unijibu mara moja.

decisions.choice: hide your face: turn away, withhold favor
decisions.reason: God's face turned toward someone is his kindness and help; to hide it is to leave that person alone (13:2; 27:9).

decisions.choice: incline your ear: listen closely
decisions.reason: To bend the ear toward someone is to listen with attention (17:6; 31:3).

decisions.choice: Do not turn away; Listen to me
decisions.reason: Readable says what the pictures mean (m1, m2).

source.text: כִּֽי־כָל֣וּ בְעָשָׁ֣ן יָמָ֑י וְ֝עַצְמוֹתַ֗י כְּמוֹ־קֵ֥ד נִחָֽרוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: For they have come to an end in smoke, my days, and my bones like a hearth have been burned.

en.L: For my days have come to an end in smoke, and my bones like a hearth are burned.
en.B: For my days are going up in smoke, and my bones are scorched like a hearth.
en.R: My life is disappearing like smoke. My body burns as if with fever, hot like a fireplace.

fr.L: Car mes jours ont pris fin dans la fumée, et mes os comme un foyer sont brûlés.
fr.B: Car mes jours s’en vont en fumée, et mes os sont brûlés comme un foyer.
fr.R: Ma vie disparaît comme de la fumée. Mon corps brûle comme de fièvre, chaud comme une cheminée.

sw.L: Kwa maana siku zangu zimekwisha katika moshi, na mifupa yangu imeteketea kama meko.
sw.B: Kwa maana siku zangu zinatoweka kama moshi, na mifupa yangu imeungua kama meko.
sw.R: Maisha yangu yanatoweka kama moshi. Mwili wangu unaungua kama mtu mwenye homa, una joto kama jiko la moto.

decisions.choice: a hearth: a place of burning
decisions.reason: The word (moqed) is a place where fire burns, or what burns there (Isaiah 33:14 uses a related word). The bones are burned out like the stones of a fireplace.

decisions.choice: days in smoke, bones burned: life wasting away
decisions.reason: Days that vanish in smoke are a life soon gone (37:20). Burning bones describe fever, or the inner pain of grief (31:11; 32:3-4).

decisions.choice: as if with fever
decisions.reason: Readable explains the picture of burning bones (m2).

source.text: הוּכָּֽה־כָ֭עֵשֶׂב וַיִּבַ֣שׁ לִבִּ֑י כִּֽי־שָׁ֝כַ֗חְתִּי מֵאֲכֹ֥ל לַחְמִֽי׃

records.literal_gloss: Struck like grass and dried up [is] my heart, for I have forgotten to eat my bread.

en.L: Struck like grass and withered [is] my heart, for I have forgotten to eat my bread.
en.B: My heart is beaten down and dried up like grass; I do not even remember to eat.
en.R: I feel crushed, like grass dried up by the sun. I am too sad even to remember to eat.

fr.L: Frappé comme l’herbe et desséché [est] mon cœur, car j’ai oublié de manger mon pain.
fr.B: Mon cœur est abattu et desséché comme l’herbe ; je ne pense même plus à manger.
fr.R: Je me sens écrasé, comme de l’herbe séchée par le soleil. Je suis trop triste pour penser même à manger.

sw.L: Moyo wangu umepigwa kama majani na kunyauka, kwa maana nimesahau kula mkate wangu.
sw.B: Moyo wangu umepondwa na kukauka kama majani; hata sikumbuki kula.
sw.R: Ninajisikia nimepondeka, kama majani yaliyokaushwa na jua. Nina huzuni nyingi hata ninasahau kula.

decisions.choice: struck like grass: scorched by the sun
decisions.reason: The verb (nakah) is used of the sun striking someone (121:6). Grass struck by the heat withers; so does the psalmist's heart, his strength and courage.

decisions.choice: for I have forgotten to eat: so weak that he does not eat
decisions.reason: The word ki may give the reason his heart dries up (he has stopped eating) or stress the result (he even forgets to eat). Either way, grief has taken his appetite (1 Samuel 1:7).

decisions.choice: I feel crushed; too sad
decisions.reason: Readable says what the picture of the heart means (m1).

source.text: מִקּ֥וֹל אַנְחָתִ֑י דָּבְקָ֥ה עַ֝צְמִ֗י לִבְשָׂרִֽי׃

records.literal_gloss: From [the] sound of my groaning my bone[s] cling to my flesh.

en.L: From the sound of my groaning my bones cling to my flesh.
en.B: All my groaning has worn me down until my bones stick to my skin.
en.R: I groan so much that I am nothing but skin and bones.

fr.L: À cause du bruit de mon gémissement, mes os collent à ma chair.
fr.B: À force de gémir, je suis usé au point que mes os collent à ma peau.
fr.R: Je gémis tellement que je n’ai plus que la peau sur les os.

sw.L: Kwa sauti ya kuugua kwangu mifupa yangu imeshikamana na nyama yangu.
sw.B: Kuugua kwangu kote kumenidhoofisha hata mifupa yangu imegandamana na ngozi yangu.
sw.R: Ninaugua sana hata nimebaki ngozi na mifupa tu.

decisions.choice: my bones cling to my flesh: wasted away
decisions.reason: The picture is of a body so thin that the bones seem to stick to the skin (Job 19:20; Lamentations 4:8). Flesh (basar) here is the skin over the bones.

decisions.choice: nothing but skin and bones
alternatives: my bones cling to my flesh
decisions.reason: Readable uses a common phrase for the same picture (m1).

source.text: דָּ֭מִיתִי לִקְאַ֣ת מִדְבָּ֑ר הָ֝יִ֗יתִי כְּכ֣וֹס חֳרָבֽוֹת׃

records.literal_gloss: I am like a desert owl of [the] wilderness; I have become like an owl of [the] ruins.

en.L: I am like a desert owl of the wilderness; I have become like an owl of the ruins.
en.B: I am like an owl out in the wilderness, a little owl in a place of ruins.
en.R: I am as lonely as a wild bird in the desert, or an owl that lives in broken-down buildings.

fr.L: Je suis semblable au hibou du désert ; je suis devenu comme la chouette des ruines.
fr.B: Je suis comme un hibou dans le désert, comme une petite chouette dans un lieu en ruines.
fr.R: Je suis aussi seul qu’un oiseau sauvage dans le désert, ou qu’une chouette qui vit dans des maisons écroulées.

sw.L: Nimefanana na bundi wa jangwani wa nyikani; nimekuwa kama bundi wa magofu.
sw.B: Nimekuwa kama bundi kule nyikani, kama bundi mdogo mahali palipoachwa magofu.
sw.R: Niko peke yangu kama ndege wa porini jangwani, au bundi anayeishi katika majengo yaliyobomoka.

decisions.choice: desert owl, owl: birds of lonely places
decisions.reason: Neither bird can be named for certain. The first (qa'at) is an unclean bird (Leviticus 11:18) that lives in ruined cities (Isaiah 34:11; Zephaniah 2:14); the second (kos) is probably a small owl. Both stand for loneliness among ruins.

decisions.choice: as lonely as
decisions.reason: Readable says what the comparison means (m1); verse 8 makes the same point.

decisions.choice: "hibou" and "chouette" for the two birds
decisions.reason: The birds cannot be named with certainty; French uses two common night birds of lonely places, as the English uses "desert owl" and "owl".

decisions.choice: "bundi" (owl) for both birds of the verse
decisions.reason: The two Hebrew birds cannot be named with certainty; the English names an owl in both lines, and "bundi" is the Swahili owl, a bird of lonely and ruined places in Swahili speech too.

source.text: שָׁקַ֥דְתִּי וָאֶֽהְיֶ֑ה כְּ֝צִפּ֗וֹר בּוֹדֵ֥ד עַל־גָּֽג׃

records.literal_gloss: I am wakeful, and I have become like a bird solitary on a roof.

en.L: I am wakeful, and I have become like a solitary bird on a roof.
en.B: Sleep will not come; I am like a single bird sitting on the housetop.
en.R: I cannot sleep. I am like a bird sitting all alone on a roof.

fr.L: Je veille, et je suis devenu comme un oiseau solitaire sur un toit.
fr.B: Le sommeil ne vient pas ; je suis comme un oiseau seul posé sur le toit.
fr.R: Je n’arrive pas à dormir. Je suis comme un oiseau posé tout seul sur un toit.

sw.L: Ninakesha, nami nimekuwa kama ndege aliye peke yake juu ya paa.
sw.B: Usingizi haunijii; nimekuwa kama ndege mmoja aliyekaa juu ya dari la nyumba.
sw.R: Siwezi kulala. Niko kama ndege aliyekaa peke yake juu ya paa.

decisions.choice: I am wakeful: I lie awake
decisions.reason: The verb (shaqad) means to stay awake, to watch. Here it is the sleepless night of someone in distress (77:5).

decisions.choice: a bird alone on a roof
decisions.reason: Houses had flat roofs. A single bird sitting there, apart from the rest, is a picture of loneliness. The word (tsippor) is a small bird.

source.text: כָּל־הַ֭יּוֹם חֵרְפ֣וּנִי אוֹיְבָ֑י מְ֝הוֹלָלַ֗י בִּ֣י נִשְׁבָּֽעוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: All the day my enemies have taunted me; [those who] mock me by me have sworn.

en.L: All the day my enemies taunt me; those who mock me swear by me.
en.B: My enemies scorn me the whole day; those who jeer at me make my name a curse.
en.R: My enemies make fun of me all day long. They use my name when they put curses on others.

fr.L: Tout le jour mes ennemis m’insultent ; ceux qui se moquent de moi jurent par moi.
fr.B: Mes ennemis me couvrent de mépris tout le jour ; ceux qui me raillent font de mon nom une malédiction.
fr.R: Mes ennemis se moquent de moi toute la journée. Ils se servent de mon nom quand ils maudissent les autres.

sw.L: Mchana kutwa adui zangu wananitukana; wanaonidhihaki wanaapa kwa jina langu.
sw.B: Adui zangu wananidharau mchana kutwa; wanaonicheka wanalifanya jina langu kuwa laana.
sw.R: Adui zangu wananidhihaki mchana kutwa. Wanalitumia jina langu wanapowalaani wengine.

decisions.choice: those who mock me: those who make a fool of me
decisions.reason: The word (mehollalay) is from a verb meaning to make a fool of, to deride; some take it as "those who rave at me".

decisions.choice: swear by me: use me as a curse
decisions.reason: They swear using his name as an example of ruin, saying "may you become like him" (Jeremiah 29:22; Isaiah 65:15).

decisions.choice: make my name a curse (B); use my name when they put curses on others (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say what the idiom means (m2).

source.text: כִּי־אֵ֭פֶר כַּלֶּ֣חֶם אָכָ֑לְתִּי וְ֝שִׁקֻּוַ֗י בִּבְכִ֥י מָסָֽכְתִּי׃

records.literal_gloss: For ash[es] like bread I have eaten, and my drinks with weeping I have mixed,

en.L: For ashes like bread I have eaten, and my drinks with weeping I have mixed,
en.B: For ashes are the bread I eat, and tears fall into what I drink,
en.R: Ashes are my food, and tears drip into my drink.

fr.L: Car la cendre comme le pain, je l’ai mangée, et mes boissons, je les ai mêlées de pleurs,
fr.B: Car la cendre est le pain que je mange, et les larmes tombent dans ce que je bois,
fr.R: La cendre est ma nourriture, et les larmes coulent dans ma boisson.

sw.L: Kwa maana nimekula majivu kama mkate, na vinywaji vyangu nimevichanganya na kilio,
sw.B: Kwa maana majivu ndiyo mkate ninaokula, na machozi yanaanguka katika ninachokunywa,
sw.R: Majivu ni chakula changu, na machozi yanadondoka katika kinywaji changu.

decisions.choice: ashes: the sign of mourning
decisions.reason: Mourners sat in ashes and put them on their heads (Job 2:8; Lamentations 3:16). His grief is so constant that ashes are like his daily bread.

decisions.choice: a sentence that runs on
decisions.reason: Verse 11 gives the cause of this grief, so the verse ends with a comma at Literal and Balanced.

source.text: מִפְּנֵֽי־זַֽעַמְךָ֥ וְקִצְפֶּ֑ךָ כִּ֥י נְ֝שָׂאתַ֗נִי וַתַּשְׁלִיכֵֽנִי׃

records.literal_gloss: because of your indignation and your wrath, for you have lifted me up and you have thrown me down.

en.L: because of {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} indignation and {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} wrath, for {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} have lifted me up and thrown me down.
en.B: because of {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} fury and {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} anger; {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} picked me up and flung me away.
en.R: It is because {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} are angry with me. You lifted me up, and then {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} threw me away.

fr.L: à cause de {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} indignation et de {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} fureur, car {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} m’as soulevé et jeté à terre.
fr.B: à cause de {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} fureur et de {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} colère ; {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} m’as pris et rejeté au loin.
fr.R: C’est parce que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} es en colère contre moi. Tu m’as soulevé, et puis {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} m’as jeté au loin.

sw.L: kwa sababu ya ghadhabu {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} na hasira {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}, kwa maana umeniinua na kunitupa chini.
sw.B: kwa sababu ya ghadhabu {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} na hasira {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}; uliniokota ukanitupa mbali.
sw.R: Ni kwa sababu umenikasirikia. Uliniinua, kisha ukanitupa mbali.

decisions.choice: your wrath: suffering felt as God's anger
decisions.reason: The psalmist does not name a sin, but he takes his trouble as coming from God's anger (90:7-9), and so he brings it to God.

decisions.choice: lifted me up and thrown me down: tossed aside
decisions.reason: The picture may be of someone picked up and hurled away, or of a dry stalk lifted by the wind (Job 30:22). God, who once raised him up, has cast him off.

source.text: יָ֭מַי כְּצֵ֣ל נָט֑וּי וַ֝אֲנִ֗י כָּעֵ֥שֶׂב אִיבָֽשׁ׃

records.literal_gloss: My days [are] like a shadow stretched out, and I like grass am withering.

en.L: My days [are] like a shadow stretched out, and I like grass wither.
en.B: My days are a shadow that stretches out as the sun goes down; I dry up like grass.
en.R: My life is like a shadow at sunset, getting longer before it disappears. I am drying up like grass.

fr.L: Mes jours [sont] comme une ombre qui s’allonge, et moi, comme l’herbe je me dessèche.
fr.B: Mes jours sont une ombre qui s’allonge quand le soleil se couche ; je sèche comme l’herbe.
fr.R: Ma vie est comme une ombre au coucher du soleil, qui s’allonge avant de disparaître. Je sèche comme l’herbe.

sw.L: Siku zangu [ni] kama kivuli kilichorefuka, nami ninanyauka kama majani.
sw.B: Siku zangu ni kivuli kinachorefuka jua linapozama; ninakauka kama majani.
sw.R: Maisha yangu ni kama kivuli wakati wa machweo, kinachozidi kurefuka kabla hakijatoweka. Ninakauka kama majani.

decisions.choice: a shadow stretched out: the evening of life
decisions.reason: A shadow grows long as the sun sets and soon is gone in the dark (109:23). His days are nearly over.

decisions.choice: as the sun goes down (B); at sunset (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say what the stretched-out shadow means (m1).

source.text: וְאַתָּ֣ה יְ֭הוָה לְעוֹלָ֣ם תֵּשֵׁ֑ב וְ֝זִכְרְךָ֗ לְדֹ֣ר וָדֹֽר׃

records.literal_gloss: But you, YHWH, forever sit [enthroned], and your remembrance [is] to generation and generation.

en.L: But {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}, {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, forever sit [enthroned], and {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} remembrance [is] to generation and generation.
en.B: But {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}, {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, are King on {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} throne forever, and {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} name lives on from one generation to the next.
en.R: But {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}, {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, rule as King forever. People in every age will remember who {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} are.

fr.L: Mais {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, pour toujours {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} sièges [sur {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} trône], et {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} souvenir [est] de génération en génération.
fr.B: Mais {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} es roi sur {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} trône pour toujours, et {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} nom demeure d’une génération à l’autre.
fr.R: Mais {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} règnes comme roi pour toujours. À chaque époque, les gens se souviendront de qui {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} es.

sw.L: Lakini {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}}, Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, unaketi [kwenye kiti cha enzi] milele, na ukumbusho {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} [ni] kizazi hata kizazi.
sw.B: Lakini {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}}, Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, u Mfalme katika kiti {{deity_pronoun:chako|Chako}} cha enzi milele, na jina {{deity_pronoun:lako|Lako}} linadumu tangu kizazi kimoja hadi kingine.
sw.R: Lakini {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}}, Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, unatawala kama Mfalme milele. Watu wa kila zama watakumbuka {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} ni nani.

decisions.choice: sit: sit enthroned as King
decisions.reason: The verb (yashav) with God as subject often means to sit on the throne as King and Judge (9:8; 29:10). The psalmist's days pass, but God's rule lasts.

decisions.choice: your remembrance: your name as it is remembered
decisions.reason: The word (zeker) is the name by which someone is remembered (135:13; Exodus 3:15).

decisions.choice: enthroned (L); King on your throne (B); rule as King (R)
decisions.reason: All three levels make the sense of the verb clear (m1); Literal brackets it.

source.text: אַתָּ֣ה תָ֭קוּם תְּרַחֵ֣ם צִיּ֑וֹן כִּי־עֵ֥ת לְ֝חֶֽנְנָ֗הּ כִּי־בָ֥א מוֹעֵֽד׃

records.literal_gloss: You will arise; you will have compassion on Zion, for [it is the] time to show favor to her, for [the] appointed time has come.

en.L: You will arise; {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} will have compassion on Zion, for [it is the] time to show her favor, for the appointed time has come.
en.B: You will stand up and take pity on Zion; the hour to be kind to her is here, the time {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} set has come.
en.R: You will get up and show Zion {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} mercy. Now is the time to be kind to her. The day {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} chose has come.

fr.L: Tu {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} lèveras ; {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} auras compassion de Sion, car [c’est le] temps de lui faire grâce, car le moment fixé est venu.
fr.B: Tu {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} lèveras et {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} auras pitié de Sion ; l’heure est là de lui faire grâce, le moment que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as fixé est arrivé.
fr.R: Tu vas {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} lever et montrer {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} bonté à Sion. C’est maintenant le moment d’être bon pour elle. Le jour que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as choisi est arrivé.

sw.L: Wewe utainuka; utaihurumia Sayuni, kwa maana [ni] wakati wa kumfadhili, kwa maana wakati ulioamriwa umefika.
sw.B: Utasimama na kuionea huruma Sayuni; saa ya kumtendea wema imefika, wakati ulioweka umewadia.
sw.R: Utainuka na kuionyesha Sayuni rehema {{deity_pronoun:zako|Zako}}. Sasa ni wakati wa kumtendea wema. Siku uliyoichagua imefika.

decisions.choice: Zion in ruins
decisions.reason: Verse 15 speaks of Zion's stones and dust: the city lies in ruins, as after its fall to Babylon (Lamentations 2:8-9). The psalm does not name the time.

decisions.choice: the appointed time: the time God has set
decisions.reason: The word (mo'ed) is a set time. The psalmist trusts that the time God fixed for Zion's restoring has come (75:3).

decisions.choice: you set (B); you chose (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say who appointed the time (m2).

source.text: כִּֽי־רָצ֣וּ עֲ֭בָדֶיךָ אֶת־אֲבָנֶ֑יהָ וְֽאֶת־עֲפָרָ֥הּ יְחֹנֵֽנוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: For your servants take pleasure in her stones, and her dust they pity.

en.L: For {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} servants take pleasure in her stones, and her dust they pity.
en.B: For {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} servants treasure her very stones and grieve over her dust.
en.R: Your people love every stone of the city. They feel sorry for her, lying in the dust.

fr.L: Car {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} serviteurs aiment ses pierres, et sa poussière, ils en ont pitié.
fr.B: Car {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} serviteurs chérissent jusqu’à ses pierres et pleurent sur sa poussière.
fr.R: Ton peuple aime chaque pierre de la ville. Il a de la peine pour elle, couchée dans la poussière.

sw.L: Kwa maana watumishi {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} wanapendezwa na mawe yake, na mavumbi yake wanayaonea huruma.
sw.B: Kwa maana watumishi {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} wanayathamini hata mawe yake na kuyaombolezea mavumbi yake.
sw.R: Watu {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} wanapenda kila jiwe la mji huo. Wanauonea huruma, ukiwa umelala mavumbini.

decisions.choice: take pleasure, pity: love for the ruined city
decisions.reason: Those who serve God still love Zion's broken stones and feel pity for the rubble (Nehemiah 1:3-4).

decisions.choice: Your people
decisions.reason: Readable says plainly who God's servants are here: the people who belong to him.

source.text: וְיִֽירְא֣וּ ג֭וֹיִם אֶת־שֵׁ֣ם יְהוָ֑ה וְֽכָל־מַלְכֵ֥י הָ֝אָ֗רֶץ אֶת־כְּבוֹדֶֽךָ׃

records.literal_gloss: And [the] nations will fear the name of YHWH, and all the kings of the earth your glory.

en.L: And the nations will fear the name of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, and all the kings of the earth {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} glory.
en.B: Then nations will stand in awe of the name of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, and every king on earth will tremble at {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} glory.
en.R: Then the nations will honor the name of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. All the kings on earth will tremble when they see {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} glory.

fr.L: Et les nations craindront le nom {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, et tous les rois de la terre {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} gloire.
fr.B: Alors les nations révéreront le nom {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, et tous les rois de la terre trembleront devant {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} gloire.
fr.R: Alors les nations honoreront le nom {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}. Tous les rois de la terre trembleront quand ils verront {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} gloire.

sw.L: Na mataifa wataliogopa jina la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, na wafalme wote wa dunia utukufu {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}}.
sw.B: Ndipo mataifa yatalicha jina la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, na kila mfalme duniani atatetemeka mbele ya utukufu {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}}.
sw.R: Ndipo mataifa yataliheshimu jina la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}. Wafalme wote wa dunia watatetemeka watakapouona utukufu {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}}.

decisions.choice: the name of the LORD: the LORD as he has shown himself
decisions.reason: God's name is God himself as he is known by what he has done (20:2). When he restores Zion, the nations will know him.

decisions.choice: your glory: the psalmist turns to God again
decisions.reason: The verse begins by speaking of "the LORD" and ends speaking to him ("your"). Such changes of person are common in the Psalms.

source.text: כִּֽי־בָנָ֣ה יְהוָ֣ה צִיּ֑וֹן נִ֝רְאָ֗ה בִּכְבוֹדֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: For YHWH has built Zion; he has appeared in his glory.

en.L: For {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} has built Zion; {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has appeared in {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} glory.
en.B: For {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} will build Zion again; {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will be seen in all {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} glory.
en.R: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} will build up Zion again. He will come and show {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} glory.

fr.L: Car {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a bâti Sion ; {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} est apparu dans {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} gloire.
fr.B: Car {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} rebâtira Sion ; {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} se montrera dans toute {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} gloire.
fr.R: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} va rebâtir Sion. Il viendra et montrera {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} gloire.

sw.L: Kwa maana {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ameijenga Sayuni; ameonekana katika utukufu {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}.
sw.B: Kwa maana {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ataijenga Sayuni tena; ataonekana katika utukufu {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} wote.
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ataijenga Sayuni upya. Atakuja na kuonyesha utukufu {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}.

decisions.choice: has built, has appeared: as good as done
decisions.reason: The verbs in verses 17-18 are in the form for completed action, but they describe what the psalmist is sure God will do (verse 14). Literal keeps the form; Balanced and Readable use the future.

decisions.choice: built: rebuilt
decisions.reason: To build Zion here is to raise it again from its ruins (147:2).

decisions.choice: will build again, will be seen (B); will build up again, will come (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable give the future sense (m1).

decisions.choice: the future at Balanced and Readable ("rebâtira", "se montrera") for the Hebrew perfect, which Literal keeps as a past ("a bâti", "est apparu")
decisions.reason: As the English: the psalm speaks of what God will surely do as if it were already done. Balanced and Readable say it as a future so a reader is not misled.

source.text: פָּ֭נָה אֶל־תְּפִלַּ֣ת הָעַרְעָ֑ר וְלֹֽא־בָ֝זָ֗ה אֶת־תְּפִלָּתָֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: He has turned to [the] prayer of the destitute, and has not despised their prayer.

en.L: He has turned to the prayer of the destitute, and has not despised their prayer.
en.B: He will listen when the destitute pray and will not wave their prayers aside.
en.R: He will listen to the prayers of people who have nothing. He will not ignore them.

fr.L: Il s’est tourné vers la prière des démunis, et n’a pas méprisé leur prière.
fr.B: Il écoutera la prière des démunis et ne rejettera pas leurs supplications.
fr.R: Il écoutera les prières de ceux qui n’ont rien. Il ne les ignorera pas.

sw.L: Ameyageukia maombi ya fukara, wala hakuyadharau maombi yao.
sw.B: Atasikiliza wanapoomba wale wasio na kitu, wala hatayapuuza maombi yao.
sw.R: Atasikiliza maombi ya watu wasio na kitu. Hatawapuuza.

decisions.choice: the destitute: someone stripped bare
decisions.reason: The word ('ar'ar) occurs only here and in Jeremiah 17:6, where it is a bare shrub in the desert: someone with nothing left. The singular stands for all such people, hence "their prayer".

decisions.choice: has turned, has not despised: the same sure future
decisions.reason: As in verse 17.

source.text: תִּכָּ֣תֶב זֹ֭את לְד֣וֹר אַחֲר֑וֹן וְעַ֥ם נִ֝בְרָ֗א יְהַלֶּל־יָֽהּ׃

records.literal_gloss: Let this be written for a generation later, and a people [that will be] created will praise Yah,

en.L: Let this be written for a generation to come, and a people [yet to be] created will praise {{divine_name:the LORD|Yah}},
en.B: Put this in writing for the generation still to come, and a people that is still to be created will praise {{divine_name:the LORD|Yah}},
en.R: Write this down for people who will live in years to come. Then people who are not yet born will praise {{divine_name:the LORD|Yah}}.

fr.L: Que cela soit écrit pour une génération à venir, et un peuple [qui sera] créé louera {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yah}},
fr.B: Mettez cela par écrit pour la génération qui vient, et un peuple qui doit encore être créé louera {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yah}},
fr.R: Écrivez cela pour les gens qui vivront dans les années à venir. Alors ceux qui ne sont pas encore nés loueront {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yah}}.

sw.L: Hili na liandikwe kwa ajili ya kizazi kijacho, na watu [watakaoumbwa] watamsifu {{divine_name:BWANA|Yah}},
sw.B: Liandikeni jambo hili kwa ajili ya kizazi kitakachokuja, na watu ambao bado hawajaumbwa watamsifu {{divine_name:BWANA|Yah}},
sw.R: Liandikeni jambo hili kwa ajili ya watu watakaoishi miaka ijayo. Ndipo watu ambao bado hawajazaliwa watamsifu {{divine_name:BWANA|Yah}}.

decisions.choice: Yah: the short form of the divine name
decisions.reason: Yah is the short form of the name YHWH, as in Exodus 15:2 and in "Hallelu-yah".

decisions.choice: a people to be created: a people God will make
decisions.reason: The verb (bara') is used only of God's creating. The new people are the generation God will bring into being after Zion is restored (22:32).

decisions.choice: a sentence that runs on
decisions.reason: What is to be written follows in verses 20-23, so the verse ends with a comma at Literal and Balanced.

source.text: כִּֽי־הִ֭שְׁקִיף מִמְּר֣וֹם קָדְשׁ֑וֹ יְ֝הוָ֗ה מִשָּׁמַ֤יִם׀אֶל־אֶ֬רֶץ הִבִּֽיט׃

records.literal_gloss: that he looked down from [the] height of his holiness; YHWH from heaven to earth looked,

en.L: that {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} looked down from {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} holy height; {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} looked from heaven to earth,
en.B: that {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} bent down from {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} holy heights and looked out from heaven over the earth,
en.R: Tell them that {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} looked down from {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} holy home above. From heaven {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} looked at the earth.

fr.L: [disant] qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a regardé du haut de {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} sainte hauteur ; {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a regardé des cieux vers la terre,
fr.B: en disant que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} s’est penché du haut de {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} saintes hauteurs, et du ciel {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a regardé la terre,
fr.R: Dites-leur que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a regardé d’en haut, depuis {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} sainte demeure. Du ciel, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a regardé la terre.

sw.L: kwamba alitazama chini kutoka katika kimo cha utakatifu {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}; {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alitazama kutoka mbinguni hadi duniani,
sw.B: kwamba {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} aliinama kutoka katika vimo {{deity_pronoun:vyake|Vyake}} vitakatifu, akatazama kutoka mbinguni juu ya nchi,
sw.R: Waambieni kwamba {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alitazama chini kutoka katika makao {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} matakatifu yaliyo juu. Kutoka mbinguni aliitazama dunia.

decisions.choice: his holy height: his holy dwelling in heaven
decisions.reason: The height (marom) is the high place where God lives (7:8; 93:4); the second line names it as heaven.

decisions.choice: Tell them that
decisions.reason: Readable starts a new sentence and makes clear that this is what is to be written down (verse 19).

source.text: לִ֭שְׁמֹעַ אֶנְקַ֣ת אָסִ֑יר לְ֝פַתֵּ֗חַ בְּנֵ֣י תְמוּתָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: to hear [the] groaning of [the] prisoner, to set free [the] sons of death,

en.L: to hear the groaning of [the] prisoner, to set free {{gender:the children|the sons}} of death,
en.B: to listen to the moaning of captives and free those marked for death,
en.R: He listened to prisoners as they groaned. He set free people who were sentenced to death.

fr.L: pour entendre le gémissement du prisonnier, pour libérer {{gender:les enfants|les fils}} de la mort,
fr.B: pour écouter la plainte des captifs et libérer ceux qui étaient promis à la mort,
fr.R: Il a écouté les prisonniers qui gémissaient. Il a libéré des gens condamnés à mort.

sw.L: ili kusikia kuugua kwa mfungwa, kuwaweka huru wana wa mauti,
sw.B: ili kusikiliza kulia kwa mateka na kuwaweka huru waliohukumiwa kufa,
sw.R: Aliwasikiliza wafungwa walipougua. Aliwaweka huru watu waliohukumiwa kifo.

decisions.choice: sons of death: those doomed to die
decisions.reason: "Son of" with a word often means one who belongs to it; "sons of death" are people condemned to die (79:11).

decisions.choice: prisoners: perhaps the exiles
decisions.reason: The prisoners may be captives in general, or Zion's people held in exile (79:11; Isaiah 42:7).

decisions.choice: the children (with "the sons" as the alternative)
decisions.reason: The phrase means anyone condemned to die (m1), so Literal gives inclusive wording by default with the traditional words as the alternative.

source.text: לְסַפֵּ֣ר בְּ֭צִיּוֹן שֵׁ֣ם יְהוָ֑ה וּ֝תְהִלָּת֗וֹ בִּירוּשָׁלִָֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: to recount in Zion [the] name of YHWH and his praise in Jerusalem,

en.L: to recount in Zion the name of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} and {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} praise in Jerusalem,
en.B: so that people may make {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}'s name known in Zion and sing {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} praise in Jerusalem,
en.R: So people will talk about {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} in Zion. They will praise {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} in Jerusalem.

fr.L: pour qu’on raconte en Sion le nom {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} et {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} louange à Jérusalem,
fr.B: pour qu’on fasse connaître en Sion le nom {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} et qu’on chante {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} louange à Jérusalem,
fr.R: Ainsi les gens parleront {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} à Sion. Ils {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} loueront à Jérusalem.

sw.L: ili kusimulia katika Sayuni jina la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} na sifa {{deity_pronoun:zake|Zake}} katika Yerusalemu,
sw.B: ili watu walitangaze jina la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} katika Sayuni na kuimba sifa {{deity_pronoun:zake|Zake}} katika Yerusalemu,
sw.R: Hivyo watu watazungumza juu ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} katika Sayuni. Watamsifu katika Yerusalemu.

decisions.choice: to recount: the purpose of the rescue
decisions.reason: God frees the prisoners so that his name will be told in Zion (verse 21). The verb has no stated subject; those set free and the new people of verse 19 are meant.

decisions.choice: people
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable supply a subject for the verb (m1).

source.text: בְּהִקָּבֵ֣ץ עַמִּ֣ים יַחְדָּ֑ו וּ֝מַמְלָכ֗וֹת לַעֲבֹ֥ד אֶת־יְהוָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: when peoples gather together, and kingdoms, to serve YHWH.

en.L: when peoples gather together, and kingdoms, to serve {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.B: when nations and kingdoms all gather to serve {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.R: That will happen when nations and kingdoms come together to worship {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.

fr.L: quand les peuples se rassembleront ensemble, et les royaumes, pour servir {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.
fr.B: quand les nations et les royaumes se rassembleront tous pour servir {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.
fr.R: Cela arrivera quand les nations et les royaumes se réuniront pour adorer {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.

sw.L: mataifa yanapokusanyika pamoja, na falme, kumtumikia {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.B: mataifa na falme zote zinapokusanyika kumtumikia {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.R: Jambo hilo litatokea mataifa na falme zitakapokusanyika pamoja kumwabudu {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.

decisions.choice: serve: worship
decisions.reason: To serve ('avad) the LORD is to worship him and live under his rule (2:11; 100:2).

decisions.choice: the nations come to worship
decisions.reason: The hope of verse 16 returns: when Zion is restored, other nations join Israel in worship (22:28; Isaiah 2:2-3).

source.text: עִנָּ֖ה בַדֶּ֥רֶךְ כֹּחִ֗י קִצַּ֥ר יָמָֽי׃

records.literal_gloss: He has humbled in the way my strength; he has cut short my days.

en.L: He has humbled my strength on the way; {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has cut short my days.
en.B: On the road of life {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has worn down my strength and made my days few.
en.R: Halfway through my life God has taken away my strength. He has made my life short.

fr.L: Il a abattu ma force en chemin ; {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a abrégé mes jours.
fr.B: Sur le chemin de la vie, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a usé ma force et réduit le nombre de mes jours.
fr.R: Au milieu de ma vie, Dieu m’a enlevé ma force. Il a rendu ma vie courte.

sw.L: Ameishusha nguvu yangu njiani; amezifupisha siku zangu.
sw.B: Katika safari ya maisha ameidhoofisha nguvu yangu na kuzifanya siku zangu kuwa chache.
sw.R: Katikati ya maisha yangu Mungu ameniondolea nguvu. Ameyafanya maisha yangu kuwa mafupi.

decisions.choice: my strength: the word as read, not as written
decisions.reason: Here the Hebrew text writes "his strength" and its notes say to read "my strength", which fits the next line. The words follow the form to be read. The ancient Greek translation follows the written form and reads the first verb as "he answered", which gives verses 24-25 a different sense.

decisions.choice: in the way: in the course of life
decisions.reason: The way (derekh) is the road of life; God has broken his strength before he reached its end.

decisions.choice: God
decisions.reason: Readable names God, who is meant by "he", at the start of the sentence.

source.text: אֹמַ֗ר אֵלִ֗י אַֽל־תַּ֭עֲלֵנִי בַּחֲצִ֣י יָמָ֑י בְּד֖וֹר דּוֹרִ֣ים שְׁנוֹתֶֽיךָ׃

records.literal_gloss: I say, My God, do not take me up in [the] middle of my days; in a generation of generations [are] your years.

en.L: I say, My God, do not take me up in the middle of my days; {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} years [are] through generation of generations.
en.B: So I say: My God, do not take me away when only half my days are done, {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} whose years run on from age to age.
en.R: So I pray: My God, do not take me away when I have lived only half my life. You live on through all the ages.

fr.L: Je dis : Mon Dieu, ne m’enlève pas au milieu de mes jours ; {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} années [durent] de génération en génération.
fr.B: Alors je dis : Mon Dieu, ne m’emporte pas quand la moitié de mes jours seulement est passée, {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} dont les années vont d’âge en âge.
fr.R: Alors je prie : Mon Dieu, ne m’emporte pas quand je n’ai vécu que la moitié de ma vie. Toi, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} vis à travers tous les âges.

sw.L: Ninasema, Ee Mungu wangu, usiniondoe katikati ya siku zangu; miaka {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} [ni] kizazi cha vizazi.
sw.B: Kwa hiyo ninasema: Ee Mungu wangu, usiniondoe wakati nusu tu ya siku zangu imepita, {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} ambaye miaka {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} inaendelea tangu zama hadi zama.
sw.R: Kwa hiyo ninaomba: Ee Mungu wangu, usiniondoe nikiwa nimeishi nusu tu ya maisha yangu. Wewe unaishi katika zama zote.

decisions.choice: take me up in the middle of my days: let me die young
decisions.reason: To be taken up is to be removed from life (Isaiah 38:10 speaks of going down to death "in the middle of my days"). The psalmist asks to live out his years.

decisions.choice: your years: God's life without end
decisions.reason: The contrast is the point: his own days are cut short, but God's years go on through all generations, as verses 26-28 go on to say.

source.text: לְ֭פָנִים הָאָ֣רֶץ יָסַ֑דְתָּ וּֽמַעֲשֵׂ֖ה יָדֶ֣יךָ שָׁמָֽיִם׃

records.literal_gloss: Formerly the earth you founded, and the work of your hands [are the] heavens.

en.L: Long ago the earth {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} founded, and the work of {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} hands [are] the heavens.
en.B: Long ago {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} set the earth on its foundations; the heavens are what {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} hands have made.
en.R: Long ago {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} made the earth and set it firmly in place. Your own hands made the sky.

fr.L: Autrefois {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as fondé la terre, et l’œuvre de {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} mains, [ce sont] les cieux.
fr.B: Autrefois {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as posé les fondations de la terre ; les cieux sont l’ouvrage de {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} mains.
fr.R: Il y a très longtemps, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as fait la terre et {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} l’as rendue solide. Tes propres mains ont fait le ciel.

sw.L: Zamani uliiweka misingi ya nchi, na mbingu [ni] kazi ya mikono {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}.
sw.B: Zamani uliiweka nchi juu ya misingi yake; mbingu ni kazi ya mikono {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}.
sw.R: Zamani uliiumba dunia na kuiweka imara mahali pake. Mikono {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} mwenyewe ilifanya anga.

decisions.choice: quoted in Hebrews 1:10-12
decisions.reason: Hebrews 1:10-12 quotes verses 26-28 from the ancient Greek translation and applies them to the Son, through whom God made the world (Hebrews 1:2). In the psalm they are addressed to God.

decisions.choice: the Creator outlasts creation
decisions.reason: The one who made earth and heaven was there before them and will remain after them (90:2). So he can be trusted beyond the psalmist's short days.

source.text: הֵ֤מָּה׀יֹאבֵדוּ֮ וְאַתָּ֪ה תַ֫עֲמֹ֥ד וְ֭כֻלָּם כַּבֶּ֣גֶד יִבְל֑וּ כַּלְּב֖וּשׁ תַּחֲלִיפֵ֣ם וְֽיַחֲלֹֽפוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: They will perish, but you will stand, and all of them like a garment will wear out; like clothing you will change them and they will pass away.

en.L: They will perish, but {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} will stand; and all of them like a garment will wear out; like clothing {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} will change them, and they will pass away.
en.B: They will come to an end, but {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} stand firm; all of them will grow old and thin like a cloak. Like worn clothing {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} will exchange them, and they will be gone.
en.R: The earth and the sky will come to an end, but {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} will last. They will all wear out like old clothes. You will change them the way people change clothes, and they will be gone.

fr.L: Eux périront, mais {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} demeureras ; et tous comme un vêtement s’useront ; comme un habit {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} les changeras, et ils passeront.
fr.B: Ils prendront fin, mais {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} restes debout ; tous vieilliront et s’useront comme un manteau. Comme un habit usé, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} les remplaceras, et ils disparaîtront.
fr.R: La terre et le ciel prendront fin, mais {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} resteras. Ils s’useront tous comme de vieux vêtements. Tu les changeras comme on change de vêtements, et ils disparaîtront.

sw.L: Hizo zitaangamia, lakini {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} utasimama; na zote zitachakaa kama vazi; kama nguo utazibadilisha, nazo zitapita.
sw.B: Zitafikia mwisho, lakini {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} unasimama imara; zote zitachakaa na kuwa nyembamba kama joho. Kama nguo zilizochakaa utazibadilisha, nazo zitatoweka.
sw.R: Dunia na anga vitafikia mwisho, lakini {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} utadumu. Vyote vitachakaa kama nguo kuukuu. Utavibadilisha kama watu wanavyobadilisha nguo, navyo vitatoweka.

decisions.choice: change them, and they pass away: one word used twice
decisions.reason: The same verb (chalaf) is used for God changing them and for their passing away: God discards the old creation as one lays aside worn clothes (Isaiah 51:6).

decisions.choice: quoted in Hebrews 1:11-12
decisions.reason: As in verse 26.

decisions.choice: The earth and the sky
decisions.reason: Readable names what "they" refers to (verse 26).

source.text: וְאַתָּה־ה֑וּא וּ֝שְׁנוֹתֶ֗יךָ לֹ֣א יִתָּֽמּוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: But you [are] he, and your years will not come to an end.

en.L: But {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} [are] the same, and {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} years will not come to an end.
en.B: But {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} are the one who does not change, and {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} years will never be finished.
en.R: But {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} never change. Your life will never end.

fr.L: Mais {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}, [{{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} es] le même, et {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} années ne prendront pas fin.
fr.B: Mais {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} es celui qui ne change pas, et {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} années n’auront jamais de fin.
fr.R: Mais {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} ne changes jamais. Ta vie ne finira jamais.

sw.L: Lakini {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} [ndiwe] yule yule, na miaka {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} haitafikia mwisho.
sw.B: Lakini {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} ndiwe usiyebadilika, na miaka {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} haitakwisha kamwe.
sw.R: Lakini {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} hubadiliki kamwe. Uzima {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} hautakwisha kamwe.

decisions.choice: you are he: you are the same
decisions.reason: The short phrase ("you [are] he") says that God stays who he is while everything else changes. God says of himself "I am he" in the same sense (Isaiah 41:4; Deuteronomy 32:39).

decisions.choice: quoted in Hebrews 1:12
decisions.reason: As in verse 26. Hebrews 13:8 says the same of Jesus Christ.

source.text: בְּנֵֽי־עֲבָדֶ֥יךָ יִשְׁכּ֑וֹנוּ וְ֝זַרְעָ֗ם לְפָנֶ֥יךָ יִכּֽוֹן׃

records.literal_gloss: [The] children of your servants will dwell, and their offspring before you will be established.

en.L: The children of {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} servants will dwell [secure], and their offspring will be established before {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}.
en.B: The children of {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} servants will make their home in the land, and their descendants will be kept safe in {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} presence.
en.R: The children of {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} people will live in safety. Their children's children will stay with {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}, safe in {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} care.

fr.L: Les enfants de {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} serviteurs habiteront [en sécurité], et leur descendance sera affermie devant {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}.
fr.B: Les enfants de {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} serviteurs habiteront dans le pays, et leurs descendants seront gardés en sécurité en {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} présence.
fr.R: Les enfants de {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} peuple vivront en sécurité. Les enfants de leurs enfants resteront près de {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}, en sécurité sous {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} protection.

sw.L: Watoto wa watumishi {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} watakaa [salama], na wazao wao watathibitishwa mbele {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}.
sw.B: Watoto wa watumishi {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} watafanya makao yao katika nchi, na wazao wao watalindwa salama mbele {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}.
sw.R: Watoto wa watu {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} wataishi salama. Wajukuu wao watakaa pamoja {{deity_pronoun:nawe|Nawe}}, salama chini ya ulinzi {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}}.

decisions.choice: dwell: live settled and safe
decisions.reason: The verb (shakan) is to settle and live in a place. With no place named, it means a settled, secure home in the land (37:29; 69:37).

decisions.choice: God's lasting years give his people a future
decisions.reason: Because God does not change (verse 28), the line of those who serve him will go on, though one life is cut short (verse 24).

decisions.choice: secure (L); in the land (B); in safety (R)
decisions.reason: Each level says what dwelling means here (m1); Literal brackets it.
